mfg1-surface-mock-02-practical-q01.stem: An exercise plate has 30 cm³ volume minus a 5 cm³ hole. At 4.0 g/cm³, what is its mass?
reasons: This does not subtract the hole.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-practical-q02.stem: An exercise liquid is 80 g/L with molar mass 40 g/mol. What is its molar concentration?
reasons: This does not convert g to mol.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-practical-q03.stem: Tank temperature is normal but filtration equipment makes unusual noise. What is appropriate?
options: Ignore it because temperature is normal
Record flow and equipment condition and report
reasons: Pressure, chemicals and restart create hazards.
This is a different unit's abnormality.
One temperature indication cannot guarantee overall normality.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-practical-q04.stem: Using an unwashed rough-polishing buff for finishing is proposed. What is appropriate?
options: Check history and cleanliness; do not reuse without approved preparation
reasons: It does not guarantee absence of contamination.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-practical-q05.stem: Before changing to another manufacturer's identical grit number, what should be checked?
options: Product system, target material and approved combination
Treat roughness and grit as the same unit
Matching numbers mean all conditions match
reasons: Number alone does not establish identical results.
Systems or material conditions may differ.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-practical-q06.stem: Hardness is measured but adhesion requirements are unconfirmed. What is appropriate?
options: Separately check the designated adhesion method
reasons: Approved methods and conditions are required.
Hardness and interface adhesion are different properties.
These are not the same requirement.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-practical-q07.stem: You are selecting a substitute white solid compound. What is appropriate?
options: Soft buffs make coarse particles irrelevant
Compare item, particles, application and buff combination
Every white product has identical composition
reasons: Color alone does not establish product suitability.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-practical-q08.stem: A particle-containing nonwoven buff is assumed unable to scratch because it is soft. What is appropriate?
options: Check particles, contamination, use and work material
Use on every material based only on softness
reasons: Softness alone does not determine machining action.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-practical-q09.stem: You want to touch a robot buff that appears stopped. What is appropriate?
options: Anyone may enter when it is motionless
Check stopping, isolation and entry procedures
Power is irrelevant only during tool changes
reasons: Restart and residual energy remain possible.
Stopped indication alone does not establish safe entry.

mfg1-surface-mock-02-practical-q10.stem: Only deep scratches remain after finishing. What should be considered next?
options: Keep maximum force at the same point
Check prior removal and dimensional allowance
reasons: This can increase heat and dimensional defects.
Avoid unauthorized overpolishing and follow causes.
